title: סלט תערובת ירקות
notes: Square-ish card with a construction-company letterhead; a name (probably the source) is written in blue at the upper left. A list of salad ingredients, last line 'רוטב:' (dressing) with 'ריבת משמש' (apricot jam). Most of the list remains unreadable.
The file 'gemini_transcribtion.txt' describes a different recipe (apple salad with mayonnaise) and was disregarded; 'gemini_transcribtion (1).txt' matches this card.
incidental_text: Printed letterhead of a contracting company group

uncertainties.text: blue name at the upper left
uncertainties.best_guess: Gemini: חיה; not confirmed on the ink

Gemini's list (order and line breaks not confirmed): חסות שונות בויניגרט; פטריות טריות; חמוציות; גזר; אגוזים; עגבניות שרי; אפרסמון; משמשים מיובשים; שקדים; דובדבנים יבשים; קולרבי; סלק חי מגורר. Our earlier reading also saw '1 ... בצל' and 'ירוק', which Gemini does not list.
uncertainties.reason: Most words unreadable; Gemini's list is only partly consistent with the ink.
Overwritten/scribbled word and a word ending in 'ות'. Gemini wrote 'ריבת תאנים [mixed with vinegar, oil, spices]', but the card clearly reads 'משמש' (apricot), and the rest is not on the card.
